usage: Render each icon by referencing #app-{id} from this SVG sprite. These are original generic app icons, not upstream trademarks. Icon presence does not imply installation, porting, licensing, or runtime support. The six additional shell shortcut symbols (voiceconnect, network, settings, store, about, docs) cover Aurora's default desktop launcher.
sprite_basis: Attached concept icon sheets sliced into individual 96x96 PNG cells.
